title: Day and Night in Venice
content: Walter Launt Palmer (American, 1854-1932) painted a similar view of Santa Maria della Salute in the daylight and moonlight.While visiting Venice in the 1890s, he painted this view on a sunny day, with warm white and orange sails reflecting in the still water, and the alabaster domes gleaming behind.He painted the same Venetian landmark by moonlight, with a cool palette and a minimal amount of detail.Both paintings are included in an exhibit called "Unmasking Venice: American Artists and the City of Water," now on view at the Fenimore Art Museum in Cooperstown, NY through September 5.
